messages:
jordan: quick flag idea: telemetry shows v1 error spikes on long seqs. propose a Console-level "soft-hide" that removes v1 from the "new route" dropdown for a tenant but keeps pinned routes. Thoughts?

leah: makes sense. Customers need a per-route risk card (seq len histogram + error heatmap) before they toggle.

pranav: operational risk is capacity shifting to v2. Console should show an estimated capacity/quota delta and a capacity guard if enabling might push v2 over safe thresholds.

jordan: implement plan: tenant toggle -> start sampled probes mirroring to v2 (default 1%) to collect latency/error/quality deltas; hide v1 for new routes; surface heatmap + estimated token/cost delta; offer opt-in bulk unpin.

sam: two asks: 1) make probes non-billable by default (probe tag & probe_bucket) to avoid billing spikes; 2) require explicit tenant opt-in for any auto-unpin.

jordan: agreed. feature flags: feature.console.soft_hide.enabled, feature.console.soft_hide.probe_rate, feature.console.soft_hide.probe_bucket, feature.console.soft_hide.auto_unpin_optin.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: feature.console.soft_hide staged to canary-1

pranav: even if probes aren't billed we need probe_volume metrics for autoscaling. emit tenant probe_volume to internal metrics so scaling reacts but billing doesn't.

leah: UI copy draft: "Hide legacy v1 for new route creation (existing pinned routes unaffected). Run sampled compatibility probes to estimate migration risk. Probes do not count toward billing by default." Add tooltip: "Probes are sampled requests routed to a non-billable probe bucket; we emit capacity metrics for planning."

jordan: alert rules: if probe fail-rate delta > 5% OR perplexity shift > 10% -> auto-pause soft-hide and create ops alert. also runbook: set probe_rate=0, disable flag, notify tenants, revert any auto-unpins.

sam: add autoscaling guard: if probe suggests >10% of tenant traffic would move and v2 cluster would exceed 70% utilization, pause auto-unpin and surface capacity reservation suggestion.

leah: also add a small per-route token-delta widget so CS can warn big spenders pre-migration.

jordan: i'll open a short PR with wireframes + backend contract and tag @pranav @leah @sam for review.
